channel.title: Go Humble! RSS Games
channel.description: Awesome RSS Feeds about HumbleBundle games bundles!

item.title: Assemble Entertainment Cozy Games Collection
item.description: Cozy up to great games this fall
item.content:encoded:
Presenting the Assemble Entertainment Cozy Games Collection! Play A Juggler’s Tale, the critically acclaimed puppet adventure, or experience the joy of running your own cozy small business by creating your own stickers in Sticky Business! Choose from adorable designs for your stickers, cutely pack orders, and build deep friendships with your customers. This warm ’n’ fuzzy bundle also includes the Book of Shadows, Seaside Tales, and Camp Zinnias DLC!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 7th, 2027.

item.title: Indies in Space
item.content:encoded:
Journey to the stars and beyond in this bundle of indie games that take outer space to the next level! Run your own lunar colony mining resources and navigating Earth-Moon politics in The Crust! Do your part waging war against the nefarious Bugs in co-op first-person-shooter Starship Troopers: Extermination and real-time strategy game Starship Troopers: Terran Command! Seek your fortune and battle your enemies in this bundle of space indies! Grab all of these and more at the price of your choice, and support Spaceship Earth charity with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 7th, 2027.

item.title: - Sniper Elite: Classics Collection
item.content:encoded:
Feel the exhilaration of lining up the perfect shot with the Sniper Elite: Classics Collection. Choose from dozens of rifles, maps, and targets across 5 complete Sniper Elite titles—including Sniper Elite 5 and Sniper Elite 4 Deluxe. Relive sweet shots with the awesome Kill Cam and immerse yourself in the strategic gameplay. Pay what you want for hours of in-depth gunplay from the ultimate shooting simulation experience, and help support Special Effect with your purchase.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 6th, 2027.

item.title: Run It Back - Roguelikes Bundle
item.description: Don’t be afraid to start over
item.content:encoded:
There are few things as high-octane as playing a fantastic roguelike game with real consequences, and to celebrate a few of our favorites we’ve collected them all in this convenient roguelike games bundle! Mine for resources to build your home and fight monsters on an alien planet in Dome Keeper! Battle your way to the top in the adorably rabbit-themed co-op game Rabbit and Steel! Save the Twisted World from falling into chaos in the single-player deckbuilder Chrono Ark! And if you die, just start all over again! There’s even more fun to be had in this bundle of roguelikes, so grab them now at the price of your choosing, and support Team Rubicon with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 2nd, 2027.

item.title: Decked Out Deckbuilders
item.content:encoded:
When the decks are stacked against you, there’s only one thing left to do—gather all the cards you can to build a bigger, better deck, and win! These deckbuilder games give players an opportunity to do just that, in a variety of different genres and exciting stories. The Roaring Twenties never looked as terrifying as they do in Cultist Simulator: Anthology Edition, where players summon otherworldly gods and steal hidden treasures. Lovecraftian occult reigns supreme in Menace from the Deep, where a secret society seeks the mythos of ancient monsters. Habitat preservation is the name of the game in Wingspan, where attracting as many birds to your deck as possible is your goal. There’s so much more to explore in this bundle of deckbuilders, so grab them now at the price of your choice, and support Worldreader with your purchase!!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 2nd, 2027.

item.title: Crawling Through the Dungeons
item.description: The depths are calling your name!
item.content:encoded:
Treasures await deep below the surface with the Crawling Through the Dungeons Bundle! Experience a beloved classic remastered for a new generation of gamers with The Bard’s Tale Trilogy—featuring updated graphics and quality‑of‑life gameplay improvements! Or change the pace with CiniCross, the dark fantasy roguelite that mixes brain‑teasing nonogram puzzles and high‑level dungeon crawling! Grab your besties or make new ones within the depths of a challenging dungeon today, and help support Direct Relief with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before March 30th, 2027.

item.title: Narrative Masterpieces
item.description: Step into the story of Narrative Masterpieces!
item.content:encoded:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Come one, come all—we’ve got some stories for you! The Narrative Masterpieces Bundle is jam‑packed with unique gaming experiences unlike any other. Headlined by Tavern Talk 2: Dreamwalker, a D&D‑inspired visual novel where tavernkeeping meets fate‑altering adventures, alongside the Drowsy Druid and Wondrous Wizard decoration packs, and IMMORTALITY, the talk‑show‑inspired interactive trilogy by Sam Barlow, this bundle offers a selection of the most inventive narrative‑focused titles in gaming. Pay what you want and help support Worldreader with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 4th, 2027.

item.title: Make & Play Games in Godot
item.content:encoded:
Pick up three games made with Godot, Buckshot Roulette, Windowkill, and The Electrifying Incident: A Monster Mini-Expedition, and the courses to help you make your own. Learn to build an action RPG from the ground up, create a gravity-defying 3D platformer, a 2D action-adventure game, and much more - with this curated bundle of approachable courses from GameDev.tv. Harness the power of Godot to bring your dream game to life, all for a price you choose, and help support Girls Who Code with your purchase.

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before September 25th, 2027.

item.title: Mega Man: Recharged Collection
item.content:encoded:
Make way for a Mega Man Bundle unlike any other with the Recharged Collection! CAPCOM’s mascot hero was originally released in 1987 and has successfully reiterated its iconic action-platformer formula every decade to remain one of the most recognizable franchises in gaming. The rewarding gameplay loop of defeating powerful bosses and upgrading Mega Man’s arsenal by copying their special attacks remains deeply satisfying in 2026. Experience certified classics for the first time with the legacy titles or dive into the latest iterations like Mega Man X Dive OFFLINE all for a price you choose. Plus, your purchase helps the Raiden Science Foundation!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 30th, 2027

item.title: CRPG Pack: Isometric Immersion
item.content:encoded:
Isometric games—that is, games that use a little projection trick to make the map look 3-D—give players a whole new way to move their characters around a world. Because we love celebrating unique perspectives, we’ve collected our favorite isometric games in one convenient bundle! Gather your crew, board your voidship, and travel through uncharted regions of space in Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader! Take on a world infested with demons and develop powers of mythic proportions in the Game of the Year Edition of Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous! Try to solve a murder while also trying to uncover your own past in the groundbreaking detective RPG Disco Elysium - The Final Cut! More fantastic adventures and unforgettable stories await you in this bundle of isometric classics, so grab them now at the price of your choice, and support Little Free Library with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 23rd, 2027

item.title: Dread and Dark Fantasies RPG Collection
item.description: Explore the depths of dark fantasy RPGs
item.content:encoded:
We’ve cast a savings spell on an epic collection of great games with the all‑new Dread and Dark Fantasies RPG Collection. Set sail for new lands in Pillars of Eternity II: Deadfire, the isometric RPG adventure filled with new content and retro‑inspired visuals; unlock three modern classics for one low price with the Torchlight I‑III Bundle; or experience the prequel sensation, DARKSIDERS: Genesis. Play these and six more of the best dark fantasy RPGs today, and help support Comic Relief with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 18th, 2027.

item.title: PAX West 2026 Bundle
item.description: Play the best of PAX West!
item.content:encoded:
Get ready to celebrate the best of nerd culture with this bundle of games in partnership with PAX West 2026! Command your heroes to victory against the Asverellian Empire in turn-based RPG Dark Deity 2! Skid and drift through the retro delights of Parking Garage Rally Circuit! Play ruthless strategy games against demonic enemies in Order Automatica! Take on the powers of gods and battle enemies solo or in co-op mode in GODBREAKERS! There’s even more nerdy fun to enjoy in this bundle, so grab these games now at the price of your choice, tune in to this year’s PAX West celebration, and support Child’s Play charity with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 18th, 2027.

item.title: Beyond the Metroidverse Bundle
item.description: The Metroidverse is calling your name
item.content:encoded:
Leave no stone unturned and kick ass in the process with the Beyond the Metroidverse Bundle. Rediscover Monster Boy and the Cursed Kingdom, the legendary Metroidvania with anime-style visuals by original series creator Ryuichi Nishizawa. Explore every nook and cranny of HunterX, the Metroidvania with a massive selection of weapons and spells to fully customize your playstyle. Or traverse a dangerous cyberpunk-inspired wasteland to find your brother in Haak. Pay what you want for a new generation of great games and help support Room to Read with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 16th, 2027.

item.title: Love Letter to Lovecraft
item.description: Our love letter to Lovecraftian gaming
item.content:encoded:
With blood dripping from our hands, we present the Love Letter to Lovecraft Bundle. Fight to rebuild what was lost as one of the last humans living in Remnant: From the Ashes, a soulslike action-adventure rooted in Eldritch themes. Embark on a journey into the darkest nightmares imaginable before you go insane in Forgive Me Father 2 Deluxe Edition, a hand-drawn Lovecraftian boomer shooter. Or maybe psychological horror is your thing—investigate the mysterious and tragic death of the Hawkins family in Call of Cthulhu. Pay what you want for thrilling experiences in gaming and help support Kiss the Ground!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 11th, 2027.

item.title: Humble 15th Anniversary - Ready Player One ... and Two
item.content:encoded:
We wouldn’t be where we are today without our friends (you!!), and to celebrate that friendship as well as our 15th Anniversary, we’ve compiled a bundle of our favorite games to play solo or with a bestie. As such, the low price tier of this bundle gets you one copy of each game, and the high tier gets you two—and saves you $4! Keep the beats bumping and the beatdowns coming in street fighting beat-’em-up Streets of Rage 4! Separate your real friends from their mimics in survival horror game Mimesis! Battle against the genetically engineered zeds in Killing Floor 3! Grab these games and more for yourself and/or a buddy for the price of your choice, and help support REVERB’s green music movement with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 11th, 2027.

item.title: Yes Chef! - Cooking Bundle
item.content:encoded:
Take your chef skills to the next level with this bundle of tasty cooking games! Whether you’re an amateur at best IRL or a seasoned professional in the kitchen, you’re sure to find the perfect cooking challenge. Keep the ale flowing and the mood high in the charmingly old-timey Tavern Manager Simulator! Let your fingers fly across the keyboard in the high-octane typing game The Chef’s Shift! (Say that three times fast.) Become the sneaky, ravenous beast you were always meant to be in arcade game Pizza Possum! Whatever your speed, whatever your tastes, this bundle of cooking games will satisfy any appetite! Grab these tasty treats while you can at the price of your choice, and support the FarmLink Project with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before March 9th, 2027.
